Plugin.Name: Disk Forecast
Plugin.Overview: Forecasts when your array, disks, pools or shares will run out of space. Disk Forecast takes a reading of free space on a schedule you choose, fits a trend to it, and shows when each target is likely to fill, with a likely range, the expected growth, a graph and a projected-usage table. A "what if I add a drive" card shows how much longer a new drive would last, a dashboard tile shows every target at a glance, and Unraid notifications warn you when something is due to fill within your chosen window. It only reads free-space figures the filesystem already keeps, so no folders are scanned and no disks are woken.
